name: Orange Cake – Milka Wonder Cake
ingredients:
REFINED WHEAT FLOUR, SUGAR, EGGS, EDIBLE VEGETABLE OIL/SHORTENING, HUMECTANTS [INS 420, INS 422], STARCH, SKIMMED MILK POWDER, SALT, RAISING AGENTS [INS 500(ii), INS 341(1), ACIDITY REGULATOR [INS 260], ANTIOXIDANT [INS 320), AND CONTAINS PERMITTED CLASS II PRESERVATIVES [INS 282, INS 202, INS 200].
CONTAINS PERMITTED SYNTHETIC FOOD COLOUR [INS 110] AND ADDED ARTIFICIAL FLAVOUR [ORANGE & LEMON].
